summary: Ubuntu 25.04 (Plucky Puffin) was released on 17 April 2025. Features: GNOME 47 or newer, kernel 6.12, continued desktop and server updates. The puffin is a distinctive seabird; 'plucky' suggests courage. Interim release on the path to 26.04 LTS.
notes: Standard support until 2026-01-15. Interim release with 9-month support.
